newsitem.title: USA: Estrogen drugs lead '96 prescription volumes - IMS.
newsitem.headline: Estrogen drugs lead '96 prescription volumes - IMS.

text.p: Prescription volume for Prempro, an estrogen product of American Home Products Corp unit Wyeth-Ayerst, grew 529 percent in 1996, while its other estrogen replacement drug Premarin remained the most prescribed drug in the United States, IMS America said.

American Home Products led drugmakers with 159.6 million prescription filled in 1996, while Pfizer Inc reported a 24 percent increase in prescriptions filled and Teva Pharmaceuticals Industries Ltd's Teva USA reported a 20 percent rise, IMS said.
IMS said a total of 2.4 billion prescriptions were dispensed in the United States in 1996, a four percent increase over 1995.
Of those, 44.8 million prescriptions were for Premarin, one percent more than in 1995, the group said. There were 7.6 million prescriptions filled for Prempro in 1996.
IMS provides healthcare marketing, sales, management and medical information and support services for the pharmaceutical industry.
